title: Tiny, cute compass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Outer compass case -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='38' fill='#f4c542' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='33' fill='#ffe28a' />
  <!-- Inner face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='28' fill='#2c2c54' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='25' fill='#3d3d78' />
  <!-- Tick marks -->
  <rect x='49' y='24' width='2' height='6' rx='1' fill='#a0e0ff' />
  <rect x='49' y='70' width='2' height='6' rx='1' fill='#a0e0ff' />
  <rect x='24' y='49' width='6' height='2' rx='1' fill='#a0e0ff' />
  <rect x='70' y='49' width='6' height='2' rx='1' fill='#a0e0ff' />
  <!-- Small tick marks diagonal -->
  <rect x='31' y='31' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#6fb7d8' transform='rotate(-45 32 33)' />
  <rect x='67' y='31' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#6fb7d8' transform='rotate(45 68 33)' />
  <rect x='31' y='64' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#6fb7d8' transform='rotate(45 32 66)' />
  <rect x='67' y='64' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#6fb7d8' transform='rotate(-45 68 66)' />
  <!-- Compass needle - north pointing red -->
  <polygon points='50,30 44,50 50,46 56,50' fill='#ff5c5c' />
  <!-- Compass needle - south pointing blue -->
  <polygon points='50,70 44,50 50,54 56,50' fill='#5cb8ff' />
  <!-- Center pin -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ffe28a' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2' fill='#ff9060' />
  <!-- Cute eyes on the face -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#e8f4ff' />
  <circle cx='57' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#e8f4ff' />
  <!-- Tiny smile -->
  <path d='M45,56 Q50,60 55,56' stroke='#a0e0ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' />
</svg>
